repairs.finding: r6_1/r6_2: codebook initialization was reported as rank-0-only, deadlocking against VQLayer.init_codebook's per-codebook distributed.broadcast calls and leaving other ranks' model-local codebooks uninitialized.
repairs.change: The trainer already invokes raw_module.init_codebook(train_embeddings.to(device)) unconditionally on every rank, before the barrier. I retained this required all-rank behavior and corrected the misleading adjacent comment to explicitly say every rank participates in the per-codebook broadcasts. Since every rank has the same train_embeddings and calls the same RQVAE/RQLayer initialization sequence, each broadcast has matching participants and all local models copy the broadcast centers.
repairs.verification: Inspected the complete initialization block and confirmed the init_codebook call is outside the rank-0 logging conditional and precedes the barrier; the VQLayer implementation broadcasts each codebook's centers from rank 0. The smoke check asserted this source structure.
